{{Quote|Look at just the conviction numbers we're allowed to see in the places we know are peaceful. An eighteen percent rise in Kaifo. Tepasi, twenty-one.|[[Mon Mothma]]|<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman">{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}}</ref>}}
'''Tepasi''' was a [[planet]]<ref name="Traveler's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Traveler's Guide to Batuu]]''</ref> located in the [[Tepasi system]] in [[Tagge Space]], a region of the [[Core Worlds]].<ref name="Appendix" /> Tepasi was the [[homeworld]] of [[Grand General]] [[Cassio Tagge]], a member of the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] who was born into the noble [[House of Tagge]].<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> It shared its name with [[Tepasi taffy]].<ref name="Pirate's Price">''[[Pirate's Price]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tepasi was first mentioned in ''[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 49]]'', a series of ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'' in-universe news articles released in [[2002]] as part of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] website written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]. The world was confirmed to be [[canon]] in the reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'', which was released in [[2015]].
